findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_booking_link, get_upcoming_trips, get_past_trips, optimize_loyalty_portfolio, get_vehicle_booking_link, get_vehicle_booking_coverage, get_hotel_reviews, get_travel_profiles, update_traveler_profile · Private data: get_rate_alerts, get_upcoming_trips, get_past_trips, get_loyalty_accounts, get_free_night_credits, get_travel_profiles, get_traveler_context, update_traveler_profile · Public sink: get_travel_profiles · Destructive: search_hotels, get_hotel_details, compare_rates, get_booking_link, predict_price, get_multi_night_rates, get_similar_hotels, search_flights, search_vehicles, get_vehicle_booking_link, diagnose_rates.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
